description: Section 9.2: quotes as the quoted message had them: nested quote marks with and without spaces and a tab, attributions at every depth (Gmail, mutt), an Outlook header block in Czech under a divider, an English header block inside a quote with a line right under it, an original-message separator, and the U+FEFF of iOS Mail.
